---
title: Guide one
_quarto:
  # Breadcrumbs, the active sidebar entry and page navigation all need
  # the project index, which a per-file smoke render lacks.
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # GH #1297 (bd-erecx4j8): the landmark names come from the
        # language table (`_language-fr.yml`). Without a navbar, the
        # sidebar is the site navigation, so it is named "Site web"
        # rather than "Section" (Quarto 1 `sidebar.ejs:1`).
        - - 'nav.quarto-secondary-nav[aria-label="Barre d''outils"]'
          - 'nav.quarto-page-breadcrumbs[aria-label="Fil d''Ariane"]'
          - 'nav#quarto-sidebar[aria-label="Site web"]'
          - 'nav#TOC[role="doc-toc"][aria-labelledby="toc-title"]'
          - 'nav.page-navigation[aria-label="Page"]'
        - - 'nav.navbar'
          - 'nav:not([aria-label]):not([aria-labelledby])'
          - '#quarto-sidebar[role]'
          - '[role="doc-toc"]:not(#TOC)'
---
